capabilities.name: tag.context.overview
capabilities.use: Confirm the nexus and the caller's role.

capabilities.name: tag.data.schema.read
capabilities.use: Approved data sets, columns, metric definitions and dialect.

capabilities.name: tag.data.query
capabilities.use: Run one read-only, organization-scoped query with bound parameters.

capabilities.name: tag.evidence.attach
capabilities.use: Record query text, parameters, data set version and result hash.

inputs.name: organization, acting principal, nexus, correlation id
approved schema and metric definitions, dialect
inputs.source: tag.data.schema.read, or definitions the user supplies

inputs.name: row limits and data-handling rules
inputs.source: approved schema definitions or organization policy

outputs.name: query
outputs.description: Read-only SELECT in the data set's dialect.

outputs.name: result summary
outputs.description: Rows or aggregate, row count, run time, data set version, caveats.

conditions: Results that feed financial reporting or a decision outside the finance function are validated with tag-validate-data and reviewed by a qualified person.
Any request touching data outside the approved definitions is referred to the data owner.
